# Jeevan Bandanadham — AI Engineer Portfolio

> Personal portfolio website of Jeevan Bandanadham, an AI Engineer specializing in production Generative AI, LangGraph multi-agent orchestration, hybrid RAG systems, LangSmith observability, and Python FastAPI backends. Based in Andhra Pradesh, India.

## About

- [Portfolio Home](https://thejeevan.in): Full portfolio with selected work, experience, capabilities, approach, field notes, and contact information.
- [Full Content](https://thejeevan.in/llms-full.txt): Complete portfolio content in a single document for full LLM ingestion.

## Selected Work

- [Project Anveshan](https://github.com/Jeevanpaul766/PROJECT-ANVESHAN): Open Deep Research Operating System — 5-agent LangGraph state machine with citation provenance, adversarial critique, novelty-saturation stop detection, and disk checkpointing. 100% verified DOI/arXiv citation integrity.
- [NyayaPath](https://github.com/Jeevanpaul766/NyayaPath): Dual-Regime Legal Guidance Agent — 12-node cyclic LangGraph agent with date-of-offence temporal routing, local hybrid RAG over 2,820 indexed statutory sections (ChromaDB + BM25 + RRF), and deterministic guardrails.
- [WorldTrendz](https://apps.apple.com/in/app/worldtrendz/id6761761956): Production Conversational AI iOS Application — live on Apple App Store, backed by secure FastAPI services, context management, and multi-model LLM orchestration.
- [Production GenAI & RAG Services at Vaaryan Interfaces](https://github.com/Jeevanpaul766): Enterprise backend architecture with Python, FastAPI, LangChain, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, GCP/Firebase, and Docker.
